_readme: Zuordnung GDELT-GKG-Theme -> Rubrik. 'themes' sind Präfixe (case-insensitive). 'query' ist der GDELT-Suchausdruck, mit dem diese Rubrik pro Ingest-Lauf abgefragt wird. Reihenfolge = Priorität bei Mehrfachtreffern.

categories.label: Naturkatastrophen
categories.query: (theme:NATURAL_DISASTER OR theme:DISASTER_EARTHQUAKE OR theme:DISASTER_FLOOD OR theme:WILDFIRE OR theme:DISASTER_VOLCANO)

categories.label: Konflikte
categories.query: (theme:ARMEDCONFLICT OR theme:MILITARY OR theme:TERROR OR theme:REBELLION)

categories.label: Friedensgespräche
categories.query: (theme:PEACEKEEPING OR theme:NEGOTIATIONS OR theme:CEASEFIRE OR theme:PEACE_TALKS)

categories.label: Politik
categories.query: (theme:ELECTION OR theme:LEGISLATION OR theme:PROTEST OR theme:GENERAL_GOVERNMENT)

categories.label: Diplomatie
categories.query: (theme:DIPLOMATIC_COOPERATION OR theme:UNGA OR theme:SANCTIONS OR theme:ALLIANCE)

categories.label: Unfälle
categories.query: (theme:MANMADE_DISASTER OR theme:TRANSPORT_ACCIDENT OR theme:FIRE OR theme:EXPLOSION)

categories.label: Wetter
categories.query: (theme:NATURAL_DISASTER_STORM OR theme:DROUGHT OR theme:HEAT_WAVE OR theme:WEATHER)

categories.label: Natur & Umwelt
categories.query: (theme:ENV_CLIMATECHANGE OR theme:ENV_BIODIVERSITY OR theme:WILDLIFE OR theme:ENV_DEFORESTATION)
